player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Níl aon fhormáid gluaiseachta bailí le fáil. Úsáid '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Imreoir {player_id}, Gníomh neamhbhailí. Tá colún {col} as teorainn.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Tá innéacs na píola {pile_index} lasmuigh den raon.
invalid_move.non_positive: Ní mór dó rud amháin ar a laghad a bhaint.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Ní féidir {quantity} a bhaint as carn {pile_index} (níl ach {pile_count} fágtha).

observation.removed_from_piles: D'imir Imreoir {player_id} [{pile_index} {quantity}], ag baint {quantity} ábhar(as) as carn {pile_index}.
